thresholds.SOC: Report first available target hit and earliest query after which every remaining saved query meets each target, with query resolution and unavailable periods. Report all selected checkpoints; early lucky accuracy is not a coverage claim.
thresholds.capacity: Report the same attainment times without an early deadline, all selected checkpoints and changes in absolute error from900 to1800 and1800 to2100. Separate late informative use from weak-tail retention. No monotonic convergence requirement from finite noisy data.
thresholds.local_qualification: Count saved local-provisional hard-error breaches for each component and aggregate; keep application accuracy unresolved uniformly. No label suppression can improve point scores.
thresholds.mechanism: Report both components, log weights, full local marginal diagnostics and post-inference oracle-best component to distinguish representation from weighting. Oracle never selects runtime output.
thresholds.baseline: Compare selected new coincident and split results with frozen bounded_online_002 control scores without rerunning it. Numerical remedy may differ, so attribute any split benefit only through the paired new arms.
thresholds.full_vector: At selected checkpoints report all16 estimated/current-truth coordinates and engineering-scaled errors; nuisance precision is not a separate universal accuracy target.

query_scope: 1s grid through10s, then10s grid plus declared endpoints; samples themselves remain35Hz with original intervals.
uncertainty_scope: Local moment ranges and hulls are diagnostics. Empirical hits/misses on one correlated trace do not validate coverage.
